content.comment_body: Hello, I'm interested in using Visual Basic to connect with my [product_name] [version_no], aiming to monitor I/O status and access some basic information. I noticed that someone has previously shared a program here, but I currently don't have Visual Basic and can't open VB files, so I'd appreciate if the code could be posted as plain text. Additionally, I need guidance on how to interact with the communication protocol used by [product_name] [version_no], including how to view and interpret the data packages, as well as how to extract or compose them. I'm unsure whether the device communicates via MODBUS TCP/IP or another protocol. Thanks in advance for any information provided.

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants to monitor I/O status using Visual Basic with their [product_name] [version_no], but lacks details on the protocol and data structure necessary for communication. Major challenges include unclear documentation on supported protocols, lack of accessible code samples outside the VB format, and uncertainty regarding the communication standard. This limitation complicates integration with other tools and software.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects detailed documentation explaining the communication protocol for their [product_name] [version_no], along with a readable example code that does not require the Visual Basic IDE for use.
